name: Choose The Context
description: A run starts grounded in the cards the request concerns.
purpose: Gives the planner the right material at little cost, so a run starts grounded in the person's own knowledge without re-discovering it.
approach: Composes the lane's context assembler, the resolver that follows a card's pointer to current text, the one ranking over cards and specification records, and the meaning index, each handed in as a seat and built on first use.
out_of_scope: Keeping and refreshing the cards themselves (Subconscious), ranking which cards a request needs (context-retriever does that), and acting on what was chosen.
milestones: 1. The area arm per_lane_assembly hands each line to the member that owns it, with no change to what the lane's assembler returns.
knowledge: The area existed as four solutions the library reached through the lane's configuration; the specification owner asked (2026-11-04) that it be a top-level solution built the way the other areas are, so the hierarchy matches the code.
measures_of_success: The context chosen for a request is the material it concerns; a reference resolves to current text; nothing is added before the reply.
parameters: Which assembler the lane runs and how its stores are built, set by the lane's configuration.
inputs: A request's text and the lane's stores.
outputs: The assembled context, the ids of the cards it drew on, a resolved reference, a ranked list of cards and records, or the cards nearest a query by meaning.
